sell.headline: Start a coding agent in a sandbox without building an image.
sell.summary: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and five more coding agents are installed in every sandbox, and their model calls go through Tangle Router on your Tangle balance.

code.text:
import os

from tangle_sandbox import BackendConfig, CreateSandboxOptions, GitConfig, Sandbox, SandboxStatus

client = Sandbox(api_key=os.environ["TANGLE_API_KEY"], base_url="https://sandbox.tangle.tools")
box = client.create(
    CreateSandboxOptions(
        git=GitConfig(url="https://github.com/tangle-network/sandbox-demo"),
        backend=BackendConfig(type="claude-code"),
    )
)
try:
    box.wait_for(SandboxStatus.RUNNING)
    run = box.prompt("`npm test` fails. Find the cause and fix it.")
    print(run.success, run.response, run.usage)
finally:
    box.delete()
    client.close()
code.proof: The result and token usage come back from one call
